subject: MSA/DPA dependency map & contingency schedule — AerialHealth pilot
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@aerialhealth.com>, Dave Lester <dave.lester@aerialhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA/DPA dependency map & contingency schedule — AerialHealth pilot

Hi Samira / Dave —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, I attached a working MAP (AerialHealth_MAP_v1.3.xlsx) that lays out the sequence we think will get you to a signed MSA + DPA + Order Form within your target window while protecting both teams from last-minute delays. High level: the DPA review + security evidence are the critical path, so we propose parallelizing order-form commercial review with legal's DPA redline to save time.

Key milestones (proposed):
- Oct 19: Redwood provides redline-friendly DPA + security Q&A (we've attached Security_QA.pdf)
- Oct 21: AerialHealth provides initial legal redlines and procurement checklist
- Oct 25: Commercial/OrderForm final internal review (Redwood)
- Oct 29: Target window for mutual sign (DocuSign)

Three asks for this thread:
1) Please confirm procurement timeline constraints (dates that are hard deadlines for your side).
2) Samira — can we get your procurement contact looped (if not the procurement@ email) so we can run their PO/finance workflow in parallel?
3) Marissa / Karthik: can legal prepare a fast-track redline plan and a fallback (standard DPA template) if negotiation drags?

Attachments: AerialHealth_MAP_v1.3.xlsx, OrderForm_Draft_AerialHealth.pdf, Security_QA.pdf

I'll coordinate a short 30-min sync tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@aerialhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Dave Lester <dave.lester@aerialhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/DPA dependency map & contingency schedule — AerialHealth pilot

Jonas —

Thanks for sending this over. A few quick notes from procurement/legal: 

- Our procurement team needs the final Order Form by Nov 5 at the latest to hit our Q4 onboarding window. That means legal needs to sign off by around Nov 2 to allow PO processing.
- We have a handful of non-negotiable items on security (data retention, deletion rights, and an indemnity cap). I attached the procurement mailbox address procurement@aerialhealth.com — they prefer to receive the final SO/Order Form along with a one-page summary of changes.
- For the DPA, legal will want to redline. Can you confirm if you can accept our proposed state residency clause? If not, we need to know early.

I can join a short alignment call tomorrow afternoon. 

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Strategic Programs | AerialHealth
samira.k@aerialhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@aerialhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/DPA dependency map & contingency schedule — AerialHealth pilot

Samira / Jonas —

Appreciate the head's up on your PO timing. Quick internal update from our side: 
- Karthik (legal) will start a DPA redline pass today and will flag state residency and indemnity cap items — we usually have a standard fallback DPA that eliminates customer-specific residency language if negotiation time is constrained.
- Priya (CS) will pull the SOC2 artifacts and the security checklist so you have evidence for procurement. Expect a zipped package and the Security_QA.pdf by later today.
- I've attached a draft OrderForm (OrderForm_Draft_AerialHealth.pdf) with the commercial terms we discussed — pricing and term windows are noted. If procurement can provide the one-page summary of their non-negotiables, we can iterate quickly.

Proposed contingency: if legal redlines extend beyond Oct 28, we propose a staged signature where the Order Form and MSA proceed with a DPA cover letter indicating 15 business days to finalize DPA specifics post-signature. This keeps your onboarding date while protecting both parties.

Jonas — can you coordinate a 30-min call tomorrow 11:00-11:30 PT? Samira — if that works, we'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@aerialhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/DPA dependency map & contingency schedule — AerialHealth pilot

Marissa / team —

I completed the first redline pass and attached Security_QA.pdf with inline notes. Short summary: 
- Indemnity cap: we can accept a mutual cap tied to contract value; unilateral customer-favored caps will require exec approval (3–5 business days).
- State residency clause: our standard position is to avoid state-specific residency clauses; we can propose a compromise data localization statement but that'll require a brief review by our privacy counsel (approx 3 business days).
- DPA turnaround: assuming a single round of comments, plan on 5–7 business days to finalize. If AerialHealth provides target language today, we can compress that to 3–4 business days.

Recommended approach: accept Marissa's staged-signature contingency (Order Form + MSA first, DPA finalized within 15 business days) if AerialHealth's procurement team requires the Order Form in place to issue a PO. This avoids blocking your Nov 5 internal deadlines.

I also uploaded a redline-ready DPA template to our internal drive and sent Samira a DocuSign placeholder link (related_links) so procurement can see the execution flow.

-Karthik
Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: procurement@aerialhealth.com
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/DPA dependency map & contingency schedule — AerialHealth pilot

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the clarity. Procurement reviewed the MAP and the draft Order Form. Our timeline constraints are firm: we must have an executed order (either signed Order Form + MSA or a PO referencing the Order Form) by 2026-11-05 to release onboarding funds for Q4. If the DPA needs extra time, we can accept the staged-signature approach provided the following are in place at signature: 
- A redline log capturing outstanding DPA items and an agreed plan for resolving them within 15 business days;
- A one-page summary of changes to the standard DPA;
- Contact (procurement@aerialhealth.com) copied on the final DocuSign envelope so finance can process immediately.

Attached: AerialHealth_PO_template.docx

We are available for the proposed 30-min call today 11:00 PT.

Procurement Team
AerialHealth
procurement@aerialhealth.com
